01 · The opportunity

Why this exists.

Real-Life Challenges extends the identity of , centered on authenticity, into a small shared pact between close friends. The opportunity sits where three trends meet:

Gen Z dominates the user base of , according to Sensor Tower UKActive reports that Gen Z is choosing healthier social habits APA identifies mental health as a defining stress for Gen Z
02 · Categories

Tap "Care" to follow the demo.

The other families are clickable so you can preview how each setup adapts. Only Care is wired through the full demo flow.

The core idea

Borrows from wellness. Borrows from mental health. Belongs to neither. The product is the connection between you and the people who matter, and how that makes small daily habits feel lighter.

Drink water. Sit in the sun. A stretch. A walk. A voice note that says "one thing I survived today", whether it was a difficult client, the snooze button, or a rough text from your boss.

Small things. Real connection. Habits that hold.
03 · Configure

Build the challenge.

After picking the family, the user sets the action, the partner, the duration, and the proof type.

Proofs stay native to the moment through Video, Dual Camera, Voice Note, or Check in. Daily ritual, format flexibility.

04 · Participation trigger

An invite with a reason.

Targets one mechanism behind declining participation: an inactive social graph can leave little reason to post, reopen, or invite someone. The invitation is not "download this." It is "do this with me."

Personal, low pressure, and designed to create a reason to join and return.

05 · Short onboarding

Short by design.

Onboarding is specific to the challenge and presents only the conditions. Each challenge type carries its own short introduction so the user does not lose momentum before Day 1.

06 · Day 1

Show up first.

After onboarding, Day 1 starts immediately. Submit the proof. Your partner's moment only unlocks once you've shown up too.

07 · Unlock

Earned, not scrolled.

Capture submitted. The partner's moment is now available. There are no streaks or scores because the reward is the moment itself.

08 · The payoff

Two people. Two real moments.

The philosophy made real. No infinite feed or metrics, just a shared challenge.

Expands 's mission without changing its core, and turns a daily post into a real connection.

09 · Widget + push

Present, not pushy.

A dedicated widget on the lock screen surfaces the partner's latest moment with minimal delay. iOS WidgetKit refreshes on the system's schedule, so the widget updates whenever the operating system allows, including when the partner adds extra proof.

Notifications keep 's tone: never pressure, always "your turn."

10 · Guided progress

The UI guides.

The challenge UI tracks remaining days, suggests the recommended proof, and adapts copy as completion nears. The interface remains minimal and aligned with the brand.

11 · Recognition

A small win, marked.

A single moment recognizes the shared completion. It feels fun without becoming a game and leads into the vault, where a pact lasting three days becomes a saved memory.

12 · Memory vault

Where it stays real.

Every proof is preserved here. Over time, vaults fold into 's existing calendar so users can revisit past challenges.

The CTA closes the loop by inviting the next pact and continuing to build meaningful habits.
